arguments.name: mode
arguments.description: Execution mode: 'folder' (source and target directories) or 'deployments' (resources from release context).

arguments.name: source
arguments.description: Directory of Deployment update definitions; required in folder mode.

arguments.name: target
arguments.description: Existing directory of Deployment YAML files to update; required in folder mode.

arguments.name: repository
arguments.description: Deployment YAML repository; used in deployments mode for UPDATE resources that do not carry their own 'repository'.

arguments.name: deployments
arguments.description: Deployment resources from release context (name, kind, action, repository, file or source, operations or container/target_image); used in deployments mode.

outputs.name: success
outputs.description: Whether every Deployment was processed without errors.

outputs.name: resources_succeeded
outputs.description: Number of Deployment resources updated or created.

outputs.name: resources_failed
outputs.description: Number of Deployment resources that failed.

outputs.name: errors
outputs.description: Errors per Deployment (kind, name, path, message).
